'''Fola''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] resident of [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]] who died along with her husband [[Kritt]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] during a cyclone. She and her family had been neighbors of [[Po Reggis|Po]] and [[Jiki Reggis]].
